latency: Measure actual final-key/global-selection tail; no 161-cycle assertion. Serial concat may delay later stack lists; reject if measured slower.
mapping: G=ceil(N/8), boundary_s=min(N,8*floor(s*G/4)); block8 stays intact, per-stack load differs by <=15 keys.
writer_contract: N is a frozen layout descriptor, shared by writer and scanner; changing it requires installed-layout acknowledgment after real key/KV migration. Repacking local row addresses is not free.
adoption: No physical/adoption until actual score gate and measured whole-model contribution.
